_usage_note: Append the matching mood template text to every scene image prompt. Also used by assemble_video.py to automatically assign motion effects per scene.
_prompt_structure: [Character card] + [Scene action from script] + [Mood template] + [Negative prompt array] + [Technical specs: photorealistic, 8K, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920]

romance_tension.label: Romance / Tension
romance_tension.prompt_text: Cinematic lighting, warm amber glow, shallow depth of field, luxury interior, emotional intensity, photorealistic, 8K, dramatic shadows, vertical 9:16
romance_tension.motion_effect_note: Ken Burns slow zoom in — romance and power moments

supernatural.label: Supernatural
supernatural.prompt_text: Ethereal lighting, deep blue and purple atmosphere, glowing particles, ancient Igbo spiritual aesthetic, mystical, photorealistic with fantasy elements, vertical 9:16
supernatural.motion_effect_note: Static with slight zoom — dialogue-heavy and supernatural reveals

revenge_power.label: Revenge / Power
revenge_power.prompt_text: High contrast lighting, deep shadows, cold blue tones with gold accents, cinematic close-up, intense gaze, photorealistic, dramatic, vertical 9:16
revenge_power.motion_effect_note: Ken Burns slow zoom in — power moments

wilderness.label: Wilderness
wilderness.prompt_text: Desaturated colours, ash and grey tones, natural lighting, overgrown vegetation, dust particles, isolated, emotionally heavy, cinematic, vertical 9:16
wilderness.motion_effect_note: Slow zoom out — dramatic reveals and isolation

covenant_villain.label: Covenant / Villain
covenant_villain.prompt_text: Dark opulent setting, candlelight, rich traditional Nigerian fabrics, ominous atmosphere, high contrast shadows, cinematic, vertical 9:16
covenant_villain.motion_effect_note: Pan right to left — tension and reaction shots

motion_effects_reference.slow_zoom_in: Ken Burns effect — slow zoom towards subject. Use for romance, power, impact moments.
motion_effects_reference.slow_zoom_out: Slow pull back from subject. Use for dramatic reveals, isolation, aftermath.
motion_effects_reference.pan_left_to_right: Horizontal pan left to right. Use for action tracking.
motion_effects_reference.pan_right_to_left: Horizontal pan right to left. Use for tension and reaction.
motion_effects_reference.static_slight_zoom: Very subtle zoom, near-static. Use for dialogue-heavy and supernatural scenes.

deep_gold_amber.use: Wealth, power, The Covenant world — luxury interior scenes

midnight_blue_purple.use: Ada's spiritual and supernatural side — awakening scenes

burning_orange_red.use: Revenge, fire, power moments — confrontation scenes
